name: – Emma Ytterell – Article 14, after § 2 – Am 110
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council on speeding-up environmental assessments
part_text: 2a. In order for a project to be considered as strategic, it shall contribute substantially to one or more of the following environmental objectives and do no significant harm to any of them: climate change mitigation; climate change adaptation; the sustainable use and protection of water and marine resources; the transition to a circular economy, pollution prevention and control; and the protection and restoration of biodiversity and ecosystems.
